name: 🥕 Crop Incremental 🌸 [New]
desc:
Welcome to 🌸 Crop Incremental! 🥕 This is a Simulator/Tycoon/Incremental game where the ultimate goal is to complete your farm! There is over 100 different farmland to unlock and 13 different seeds. Along with 20+ Upgrades! Farming game!

💎 JOIN THE GROUP AND LIKE THE GAME TO EARN 2,500 DIAMONDS!!! 💎

If you have any feedback for the game, make sure to leave it in my roblox group!

Tips:
Radishes are useful for getting diamonds quickly! 🌾
Farmers harvest crops while you're afk 🧑‍🌾
Idle Progress only gives an hour worth of money and diamonds! 💎

Update 1 (2-3-25)
